title: Hidden Weapon
paragraphs: We headed straight to the weapon shop, which had already closed for the night, and knocked on the door. A faint light was leaking from inside—seemed like they hadn’t gone to bed yet.
“What is it? I was just about to turn in for the night… Wait, aren’t you the guys from earlier today?”
“Apologies for disturbing you this late at night.”
“What do you want at this hour? If you need weapons, come back tomorrow.”
The shopkeeper sounded a bit annoyed. Well, given the time, that was understandable.
“For now, I’d like you to take a look at this.”
I handed him the chainmail that the damn pig had given me. The shopkeeper took it, tilted his head, and examined it.
“Huh? This is the one that shield guy bought, isn’t it?”

He scrutinized it with a puzzled expression. As the owner of a shop dealing in goods, it made sense that he’d recognize it. Besides, Father had said in the first world that this man was trustworthy. Even in the previous loops, he had helped us out—definitely someone we could rely on.
“Yeah, no doubt about it. The serial number matches too.”
Ren and Itsuki watched the shopkeeper’s reaction closely.
“How exactly did you guys get this? Don’t tell me you stole it from shield guy?”
“This… doesn’t seem like an act.”
“Yeah, if it was an act, it’d be a damn good one.”
“What are you guys even doubting me for?”
“This was given to me just earlier by one of Naofumi’s own party members.”
“What!?”
The shopkeeper let out a shocked cry. Then, after a moment, he spoke as if something had clicked.
“Ah… shield guy was acting all smitten with that girl back then. So she ended up using him, huh? Yeah… I got that impression.”
“I’ve been wondering—do you know who she really is?”
The shopkeeper had been cooperative with Father, but was he actually aware of the kingdom’s affairs? Since I had no idea, it was worth asking.
“Huh? I feel like I’ve seen her somewhere before, but no, I don’t know her. I’ve been running this shop for a long time, and I’m pretty sure she was a first-time customer.”
“She’s the princess of this country. She’s been pretending to be an adventurer.”
“…I have heard something like that before. Of the two princesses in this kingdom, the older one was supposedly sent abroad for being a nasty piece of work, and the younger one is still just a kid.”

Now that he mentioned it, I did recall the damn pig saying something along those lines before. Ugh, I’d rather erase that memory altogether. That piece of filth and everything about her should be tossed away like garbage.
“So? You guys came here to check if this really belongs to shield guy? Feels like you’re doing things in a weird order.”
“That’s right. This chainmail—there’s no doubt that it belongs to Naofumi, correct?”

“Yeah, I can vouch for that. This is definitely the one I sold to shield guy. You guys should take a look too. All weapons and armor in this country are assigned a serial number to track their maker. See? It’s right here.”
The shopkeeper pointed to the engraving and serial number on the chainmail. Ren and Itsuki couldn’t read numbers in the script of this world, but they should at least recognize the markings.
“Man… shield guy’s really had it rough. Hope they haven’t stripped him down completely by now.”

They already have. I want to protect Father’s smile. In the future, after this incident, he refused to wear chainmail ever again. It was the same in every loop. But I… I want to see him smiling while wearing this chainmail.
“I don’t feel great knowing something from my shop was used in a crime. Well, if you guys return it, I’ll cut you a little deal next time you come by.”

Will there even be a next time? At this rate, staying in Melromarc won’t be an option for long. If that’s the case, I’d rather take the discount now—but unfortunately, I don’t have much money on hand.
…Now that I think about it, the old man had an orichalcum shield. A sword or bow of the same grade would be a huge help. Might as well ask.
“Then, do you have any weapons made of orichalcum? If you have a sword and bow, could you lend them to us for just a few minutes?”
“Huh? Spear guy, how the hell do you know I’ve got that in my shop?”
Ren and Itsuki’s eyes sharpened at his reaction. Well, those weapons contain incredibly powerful skills, and I also knew they weren’t displayed openly in the shop.
“Honestly, I’d rather not show them to you… but fine. You don’t need a spear?”
“I have no need for one.”
Reluctantly, the shopkeeper went to the back and brought out a sword and bow for Ren and Itsuki to copy. As for Father… I’ll ask if we have the chance later.
“These aren’t for sale.”
“That’s not an issue. Now, Ren, Itsuki, use that copying skill you discovered today.”
“Got it. What kind of effect do these weapons have?”
“Think of them as part of the Meteor series.”
“Whoa…!”

Ren and Itsuki each touched a weapon and completed the copying process. They looked a bit confused but also excited to unexpectedly acquire such rare weapons. Well, if they hadn’t gotten them here, they would’ve had to travel all the way to Zeltoble. This just saved them a lot of time.
“Copy? What’s that?”
“Well, you see, heroes can copy and use weapons just by touching the ones sold in stores.”
“Motoyasu—”
“You should not have said that just now!”
I went ahead and explained the hero weapon’s ability to the shopkeeper.
“Hoh… So what you’re saying is, the sword and bow guys here just stole from my shop?”
The shopkeeper cracked his knuckles loudly. Ren and Itsuki took a nervous step back, sweat forming on their brows. But I simply raised my spear and met his gaze.
“I sincerely apologize for that. But… we don’t know if we’ll ever be able to return to this shop again, so we had no choice but to ask for this favor.”
The shopkeeper stroked his chin, thinking for a moment.
“Hmph… You’re a reckless one, but I can see you mean well. And since shield guy’s having a rough time, if this helps him, I’ll let it slide.”
As expected from someone Father trusted in the first world. He understands reason.
“Then, our business here is done. Things will get noisy tomorrow, so please be careful.”
“Got it. Better to have a warning than be caught off guard…”
With that, we left the weapon shop. As soon as we stepped outside, Ren and Itsuki let out deep sighs.
“Phew… I thought we were done for.”
“Seriously, I thought he was going to kill us. Motoyasu, you talk too much.”
“He was a good person in the future too, so I figured talking would work. More importantly, I need you two to see something.”

I transformed my spear into an orichalcum spear. This proved that I hadn’t copied it just now. Though, to be fair, they could argue I had copied it earlier, so as proof, it was a bit shaky. Still, they should understand that transforming a weapon into orichalcum requires a certain level.
“Meteor Spear!”
I aimed it upward, and a beautiful streak of stardust shot across the sky.
“Whoa…”

“Now do you understand? I came from the future. My strength is proof of that. You can come up with a hundred reasons to doubt me, but right now, we don’t have time for that. I will protect Ren, Itsuki, and most importantly, Father—so that we all survive.”
In Ren and Itsuki’s eyes, I could see a glimmer like the stars above.
“The kingdom’s conspiracy… If what Motoyasu says really happens tomorrow morning…”
“Doubt is easy. But I don’t have any proof to justify it right now. For now… I’ll believe you.”
We exchanged nods, mentally preparing for what was to come. Finally, they believed me. Now, the next step was saving Father.
“Alright, next we need to save Father.”
“Are we waking him up now?”
“No, if we do that, Naofumi might think we are the culprits.”
“Good point. Based on what I know from previous loops, it’s best to step in right when he’s being falsely accused.”
“…That makes sense. If we stand by Naofumi and defend him when he realizes he’s been deceived, he’s more likely to trust us.”
“Then tomorrow, when we’re summoned to the castle, we’ll put on a little act—”
We continued planning our strategy to save Father. With Ren and Itsuki on board, we will save him!
